name: Cafe Deux Femmes
source: While visiting her sister in Los Angeles for thanksgiving, Hannah finds that she doesn’t quite have enough money to do all the sightseeing she’d like to do. Fortunately, her sister’s best friend offers Hannah work at her café for the three days before Thanksgiving. Those three days become crucial as Hannah discovers who she truly is while working at the “Café Deux Femmes”.
translation: 汉娜在洛杉矶探望姐姐过感恩节时，发现她没有足够的钱去参观她想做的所有观光活动。幸运的是，她姐姐最好的朋友为汉娜提供了感恩节前三天在她的咖啡馆工作的机会。当汉娜在“Café Deux Femmes”工作时发现自己的真实身份时，这三天变得至关重要。
